page.overview:
What is Decepticons?

Starscream (temporarily) Steeljaw (Leader of Steeljaw's Pack) Glowstrike, Saberhorn and Scorponok (Leaders of Decepticon Island Forces)

Seekers Constructicons Combaticons Stunticons Seacons Starscream's Vehicon Armada Steeljaw's Pack Decepticon Island Forces Decepticon Scavengers Starscream's Mercenaries

The Decepticons are a group of Cybertronians whose original goal was to get rid of the infamous Caste System on Cybertron and return to the empire-building, space-faring ways of their ancestors. The name "Decepticon" came from prewar propaganda by the Autobot High Council, labeling them liars and thieves. They took the title as something honorable instead; in their minds and Megatron's words, "if speaking the truth [was] deception, then [they were] gladly guilty."

In the Great War and long after, they were opposed by the Autobots. Occasionally both would put aside their differences for mutual threats only to resume fighting later.

Also known as: Decepticon.
